<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover">
  <title>Para ti 💗</title>
  <style>
    *{box-sizing:border-box}
    html,body{margin:0;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#ffdce8;font-family:Arial,sans-serif}
    body{display:grid;place-items:center}
    .scene{position:relative;width:min(100vw,calc(100vh * 1374 / 1145));aspect-ratio:1374 / 1145;overflow:hidden;border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(128,35,70,.18)}
    .scene img{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}

    /* Botones reales, transparentes y colocados sobre los botones de la imagen. */
    .hit{position:absolute;z-index:20;cursor:pointer;background:transparent;border:0;padding:0;border-radius:999px}
    .yes{left:25.2%;top:80.4%;width:24%;height:10%}
    .no{left:50%;top:80.7%;width:23.4%;height:9.7%}
    .hit:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #fff;outline-offset:4px}

    .fx{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:10;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden}
    .particle{position:absolute;bottom:-50px;animation:rise linear forwards;filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 8px rgba(140,38,83,.18))}
    @keyframes rise{
      0%{transform:translate3d(0,0,0) scale(.7) rotate(0deg);opacity:0}
      10%{opacity:.95}
      100%{transform:translate3d(var(--dx),-120vh,0) scale(1.25) rotate(var(--rot));opacity:0}
    }

    .finish{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:50;display:grid;place-items:center;background:rgba(255,220,232,.4);backdrop-filter:blur(4px);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .45s ease}
    .finish.show{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}
    .finish-card{padding:34px 58px;border-radius:32px;background:rgba(255,245,249,.97);box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(121,34,71,.22);text-align:center;transform:scale(.82);transition:transform .45s cubic-bezier(.2,.85,.25,1.25)}
    .finish.show .finish-card{transform:scale(1)}
    .finish-word{margin:0;color:#7a1740;font-size:clamp(3.2rem,11vw,7rem);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.08em;text-shadow:0 4px 18px rgba(122,23,64,.14)}
    .finish-heart{margin-top:6px;font-size:clamp(2rem,5vw,3.5rem);animation:pulse 1.2s infinite}
    @keyframes pulse{0%,100%{transform:scale(1)}50%{transform:scale(1.15)}}

    @media (max-aspect-ratio:1/1){
      .scene{width:100vw;border-radius:0;box-shadow:none}
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <main class="scene" aria-label="Carta especial">
    <img alt="Carta romántica. Para ti. Atte: Tu futuro problema favorito :) ¿Quieres abrir esta carta?" src="data:image/png;base64,">

    <div class="fx" id="fx"></div>

    <button class="hit yes" id="yes" aria-label="Sí"></button>
    <button class="hit no" id="no" aria-label="No"></button>

    <section class="finish" id="finish" aria-live="polite" aria-hidden="true">
      <div class="finish-card">
        <h1 class="finish-word">FIN</h1>
        <div class="finish-heart">💗✨</div>
      </div>
    </section>
  </main>

  <script>
    const finish = document.getElementById('finish');
    const fx = document.getElementById('fx');

    function createParticle(){
      const el = document.createElement('span');
      el.className = 'particle';
      el.textContent = Math.random() < 0.58 ? '💗' : '✨';
      el.style.left = Math.random() * 100 + '%';
      el.style.fontSize = (18 + Math.random() * 26) + 'px';
      el.style.animationDuration = (3.5 + Math.random() * 3.5) + 's';
      el.style.setProperty('--dx', (Math.random() * 180 - 90) + 'px');
      el.style.setProperty('--rot', (Math.random() * 180 - 90) + 'deg');
      fx.appendChild(el);
      setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 8000);
    }

    setInterval(createParticle, 650);
    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) setTimeout(createParticle, i * 180);

    function end(){
      if (finish.classList.contains('show')) return;
      finish.classList.add('show');
      finish.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
      for (let i = 0; i < 22; i++) setTimeout(createParticle, i * 45);
    }

    document.getElementById('yes').addEventListener('click', end);
    document.getElementById('no').addEventListener('click', end);
  </script>
</body>
</html>
